An Ordinance

[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, dated 12-4-2001]
No. Legis.4-23/Law/71/2219-20,
dated 12-4-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 9th April, 2001 is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Motor
Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Substitution of section 32 of Ordinance XIX of 1965

BALOCHISTAN MOTOR
VEHICLES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE VIII OF
2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, dated 12-4-2001]
No. Legis.4-23/Law/71/2219-20,
dated 12-4-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 9th April, 2001 is hereby published for general information:--
2. Substitution of section 32
of Ordinance XIX of 1965.--In the Balochistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance,
1965 for section 32, the following shall be substituted:--
"32. Sale
of Motor Vehicles and Transfer of ownership.--(1) Sale of any motor
vehicle, registered under this Chapter and transfer of its ownership shall be
in prescribed manner.
(2) Contravention of this Section
or the Rules made thereunder shall be punishable by the Registering Authority
with fine which may not be less than 25% of the transfer fee for every
defaulting month.
